description: Stacked highlight-box title: each line sits on its own colour block; blocks wipe in with a stagger, text rises inside them, slight tilt optional; exits by wiping away. Social / ad / hook titles over footage. Transparent.

params.text: Lines separated by | (max 3), e.g. 'The idea lives|in the layout.'
params.position: center | top-left | top | top-right | left | right | bottom-left | bottom | bottom-right (default center)
params.ink: Text colour on the blocks, default #0B0B10
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output
